d:
You cannot take your eyes off from this bubbly and bindaas performance of Alia Bhatt. Let's revive our memories once again with this song. Watch Full Video song "Patakha Guddi" (Female Version) from the movie Highway. The Music of this movie is composed by none other than A.R Rahman and sung by Nooran Sisters - Sultana and Jyoti Nooran. Lyrics are written by Irshaad Kamil.
Song: Pataka Guddi
Singer: Sultana and Jyoti Nooran
Music: A.R Rahman
Lyrics: Irshad Kamil
Movie: Highway
Directed By: Imtiaz Ali
Starring: Alia Bhatt, Randeep Hooda and Others
